versions.content: If development error detection is enabled for NvM module, the job of the function NvM_InvalidateNvBlock shall report the DET error NVM_E_WRITE_ONCE_STATUS_UNKNOWN when a write request is made for a block configured with NVM_WRITE_BLOCK_ONCE (TRUE) for which no read request was made prior to this.
